OpportunityProductRecipient.name: OpportunityProductRecipient
OpportunityProductRecipient.description: Represents a site that receives services or utilities related to an opportunity.

OpportunityId.description: Required. The opportunity associated with the energy site.

ServicePointMarketIdentifier.description: The identifier of the service point generated by an external system.

ServiceType.description: Specifies the type of service delivered to the service point.

EstimatedAnnualConsumption.description: The number of units of the service estimated to be consumed at the service point annually.

IsIndustryVldRequested.description: Indicates whether an external validation check is requested for the service point. The default value is false.

IdstVldLastRunDateTime.description: The date and time that an external validation was requested.

IndustryValidationStatus.description: The latest response from the external validation check.

DistributionArea.description: The distribution area of the service point, usually indicated using the name of the city.

ServiceAddress.description: The address where the recipient receives the service.

UnitOfMeasureId.description: Specifies the measurement unit of the service, such as kWh for electricity.
